task_metadata.research_topic: KV-state structural reduction for GPT-style causal language model pretraining
task_metadata.research_question: Design an attention structure that preserves small-scale GPT pretraining quality while reducing realized KV-cache footprint through head sharing or latent KV compression.
notes: Baselines map to the intended MHA -> MQA -> GQA -> MLA structural chain.

The visible eval-* settings are lightweight replays from the train-ctx1024 final metrics snapshot, matching mature nanoGPT task practice of training once and evaluating held-out corpora from that checkpoint.

tests.label: train-ctx1024
tests.notes: Primary 124M ctx1024 autoregressive pretraining run. The script also emits WikiText-2/103 and LAMBADA aux metrics that the eval-* replay scripts expose as separate leaderboard settings.

tests.label: train-ctx256
tests.notes: Hidden short-context robustness run. WikiText/LAMBADA visible eval settings are replayed from train-ctx1024 aux metrics, not separate training commands.

tests.label: eval-wikitext2
tests.notes: Lightweight replay of WikiText-2 metrics emitted by the final train-ctx1024 checkpoint.

tests.label: eval-wikitext103
tests.notes: Lightweight replay of WikiText-103 metrics emitted by the final train-ctx1024 checkpoint.

tests.label: eval-lambada
tests.notes: Lightweight replay of LAMBADA metrics emitted by the final train-ctx1024 checkpoint.

baselines.name: mha
baselines.notes: Dense multi-head attention control with one KV head per query head.

baselines.name: mqa
baselines.notes: Multi-query attention anchor with one shared KV head reused across query heads.

baselines.name: gqa
baselines.notes: Grouped-query attention anchor between dense MHA and one-head MQA.

baselines.name: mla
baselines.notes: MLA-style latent KV bottleneck adapted into the fixed nanoGPT attention scaffold.
